EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches (2989, 2940, 2892 cm⁻¹; GFQ-003) and a carbonyl near 1733 cm⁻¹ consistent with an ester C=O. Multiple bands in the 1083–1184 cm⁻¹ region fit C–O stretching of an ester, and a CH bending band at 1458 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) is present. There are no N–H stretches (~3300–3400 cm⁻¹; GFQ-002) or isocyanate ν(N=C=O) near ~2270 cm⁻¹, which disfavors candidates with amide/NC=O functionality. Between the two aliphatic esters (1 and 2), both fit, but 1 is the simplest match to the observed pattern without additional features.
